ethics.title: Strict Geodata Protection
ethics.warning: To protect free-roaming animals from poisoning or unauthorized culling, raw coordinates are NEVER publicly disclosed.
points: Exact GPS positions are visible only to signed-in Hawem volunteers and researchers. Exports and public maps show a 1 km grid, never your exact position.
Public maps display only anonymized, aggregated 1 km² density cells.
You can export or delete your account and all contributed data at any time.

ui_consent.hawem_powers_structured_stray_dog_and: Hawem collects structured surveys of free-roaming cats and dogs, so researchers and local groups can monitor their populations and welfare.
ui_consent.replacing_guesswork_with_calibrated_dist: Replacing guesswork with calibrated distance-sampling walks and reproducible spatial routes.
ui_consent.observing_body_condition_bcs_1_5: Observing body condition (BCS 1-5), reproductive status, ear-notches, and rabies vaccination tags.
ui_consent.data_drives_humane_trap_neuter_vaccinate: Data drives humane trap-neuter-vaccinate-return (TNVR) allocation rather than lethal culling.
ui_consent.scientific_surveys_record_your_track_con: Scientific surveys record your track continuously to estimate total animal density per square kilometer.
ui_consent.walk_at_a_normal_steady_pace: Walk at a normal steady pace (2 to 5 km/h). Avoid lingering in one spot. Speeds above 15 km/h are filtered out.
ui_consent.a_transect_where_you_see_zero: A transect where you see zero animals is high-value negative evidence. It proves absence in that zone and earns equal scientific XP.
ui_consent.note_how_far_an_animal_is: Note how far an animal is from your walk line. Distance modeling mathematically corrects for animals missed further away.
ui_consent.we_explain_why_each_sensor_is: We explain why each sensor is required before your operating system displays a prompt.
ui_consent.records_gps_track_points_and_calculates: Records GPS track points and calculates distance and pace while performing transect walks.
ui_consent.keeps_recording_your_transect_line_even: Keeps recording your transect line even when your phone is locked or screen is off in your pocket.
ui_consent.allows_capturing_flank_and_face_photogra: Allows capturing flank and face photographs for individual animal re-identification and body scoring.
ui_consent.observing_free_roaming_animals_requires_: Observing free-roaming animals requires adherence to strict ethics and privacy principles.
ui_consent.high_resolution_coordinates_are_strictly: High-resolution coordinates are strictly confidential and never publicly released, preventing municipal culling or poisoning risks. Public maps display only aggregated cells.
ui_consent.never_chase_corner_corner_or_handle: Never chase, corner, corner, or handle free-roaming animals. Observe from a calm distance without altering natural behavior.
ui_consent.never_photograph_bystanders_private_prop: Never photograph bystanders, private properties, or license plates. All photos are automatically scrubbed of EXIF metadata before upload.
ui_consent.i_accept_the_scientific_ethics_charter: I accept the scientific ethics charter, privacy terms, and versioned protocol ({{CURRENT_CONSENT_VERSION}}).

ui_training.fauna_observatory_free_roaming_animal_po: Fauna Observatory • Free-Roaming Animal Population Research
ui_training.this_credential_certifies_that_the_surve: This credential certifies that the surveyor has demonstrated complete competency in standardized transect pacing, perpendicular distance sampling estimation, ICAM body condition scoring, and eBird complete checklist non-detection protocols.
ui_training.scientific_density_modeling_requires_con: Scientific density modeling requires constant, standardized observer effort.
ui_training.maintain_a_steady_walking_pace_3: Maintain a steady walking pace (~3.0 to 4.0 km/h) along the entire transect.
ui_training.keep_gps_active_continuously_start_and: Keep GPS active continuously; start and end times record the exact survey duration.
ui_training.never_deviate_off_trail_to_search: Never deviate off-trail to search behind bushes or inside private properties.
ui_training.why_must_surveyors_maintain_a_consistent: Why must surveyors maintain a consistent walking pace without searching off-trail?
ui_training.to_maximize_the_sheer_quantity_of: To maximize the sheer quantity of animals spotted in the neighborhood
ui_training.to_ensure_standardized_observer_effort_p: To ensure standardized observer effort per unit of distance for statistical density estimation
ui_training.to_minimize_mobile_phone_battery_consump: To minimize mobile phone battery consumption during GPS tracking
ui_training.consistent_pace_standardizes_the_detecti: Consistent pace standardizes the detection probability function g(x) across time and space, allowing statistical models to extrapolate true population size.
ui_training.distance_sampling_relies_on_the_90: Distance Sampling relies on the 90° perpendicular offset from the transect line.
ui_training.perpendicular_distance_is_the_shortest_d: Perpendicular distance is the shortest distance from the centerline to the initial animal location.
ui_training.record_the_animal_location_at_the: Record the animal location at the exact instant of first detection, before it moves.
ui_training.detection_directly_on_the_centerline_is: Detection directly on the centerline is assumed to be certain: g(0) = 1.0.
ui_training.which_distance_measurement_is_mathematic: Which distance measurement is mathematically required for Distance Sampling models?
ui_training.the_straight_line_diagonal_distance_from: The straight-line diagonal distance from the observer when first spotted
ui_training.the_90_degree_perpendicular_distance_fro: The 90-degree perpendicular distance from the transect path centerline to the animal
ui_training.the_distance_the_animal_runs_away: The distance the animal runs away after noticing the observer
ui_training.distance_sampling_specifically_integrate: Distance Sampling specifically integrates the perpendicular distance distribution to model how detection probability decays away from the line.
ui_training.a_validated_5_point_visual_scale: A validated 5-point visual scale assessing animal nutritional and welfare state.
ui_training.score_1_emaciated_ribs_lumbar_vertebrae: Score 1 (Emaciated): Ribs, lumbar vertebrae, and pelvic bones visibly prominent.
ui_training.score_2_thin_ribs_easily_visible: Score 2 (Thin): Ribs easily visible; distinct waist hourglass silhouette.
ui_training.score_3_ideal_ribs_easily_palpable: Score 3 (Ideal): Ribs easily palpable with light fat cover; well-proportioned body.
ui_training.score_4_overweight_heavy_fat_cover: Score 4 (Overweight): Heavy fat cover along lumbar vertebrae and base of tail.
ui_training.score_5_obese_distended_abdomen_with: Score 5 (Obese): Distended abdomen with heavy subcutaneous fat deposits.
ui_training.an_adult_dog_has_easily_visible: An adult dog has easily visible ribs and an hourglass waist, but lumbar spine bones do not severely protrude. What is the ICAM score?
ui_training.score_2_indicates_a_thin_animal: Score 2 indicates a thin animal with easily visible ribs and waist indentation, without the severe muscle wasting and bone protrusion of Score 1.
ui_training.individual_identification_requires_captu: Individual identification requires capturing unique, asymmetric coat patterns.
ui_training.left_and_right_flanks_of_cats: Left and right flanks of cats and dogs have distinct pigmentation patterns.
ui_training.a_full_id_set_requires_3: A full ID set requires 3 standardized angles: Left Flank, Right Flank, and Face.
ui_training.note_ear_tipping_a_straight_horizontal: Note ear-tipping: a straight horizontal tip notch on the left ear indicates a sterilized animal (TNR).
ui_training.why_is_a_single_flank_photograph: Why is a single flank photograph often insufficient for capture-recapture re-identification?
ui_training.because_coat_pigmentation_and_tabby_stri: Because coat pigmentation and tabby stripes are asymmetric between left and right sides
ui_training.because_the_camera_sensor_cannot_process: Because the camera sensor cannot process colors from only one perspective
ui_training.because_free_roaming_animals_change_coat: Because free-roaming animals change coat color seasonally
ui_training.mammalian_coat_patterns_develop_through_: Mammalian coat patterns develop through complex embryological migration, creating unique asymmetric patterns on either side. Both flanks are needed to confirm matches from any angle.
ui_training.in_population_ecology_recording_zero_ani: In population ecology, recording zero animals is just as valuable as recording fifty.
ui_training.if_you_walk_2_km_along: If you walk 2 km along a transect and see no animals, keep the survey.
ui_training.confirm_yes_on_the_final_complete: Confirm "Yes" on the final complete checklist: you searched and saw zero animals.
ui_training.non_detection_data_is_the_mathematical: Non-detection data is the mathematical foundation for Occupancy and N-mixture models.
ui_training.full_completion_xp_awarded_for_zero: Full completion XP awarded for zero counts
ui_training.you_walked_a_2_5_km: You walked a 2.5 km transect for 40 minutes and saw zero cats and zero dogs. What should you do?

ui_training.non_detections_establish_the_absence_pro: Non-detections establish the absence probability in statistical models. In Hawem, complete zero-count surveys receive full effort XP (+20 XP completion bonus) with zero penalty.
